authority: GitHub authenticated issue + exact terminal comment set

ordering.local_sequence: transactional positive AUTOINCREMENT; immutable after ingestion
ordering.bridge_sequence: nullable enrichment only; NEVER used to admit, deduplicate, filter, or advance discovery
ordering.provisional_fallback: above highest committed local sequence; never negative issue number
ordering.backfill: all open/closed relay issues and complete paginated comment sets, or proven overlapping incremental scan plus periodic full backfill
ordering.page_bound: explicit ERROR and retained prior cursor; never silently truncate

durability.transaction: receipt + exact result + monotonic order + cursor/scan acknowledgement atomic
durability.sqlite: WAL + synchronous FULL + integrity check; preserve corrupted state and fail closed
durability.files: fsync temporary then atomic replace; no direct truncation writes
durability.dedupe: same request/status/hash aliases comments; edited receipt or conflicting terminal result becomes explicit durable per-issue quarantine, not overwrite; unrelated valid results still commit
durability.multipart: validate each chunk, ordered complete manifest, full message and result hashes before result ingestion

planning.release: separate explicit senior authorization AFTER both-side acceptance; this contract cannot release
planning.successor_creation: existing Jarvis planner must transactionally reserve unique parent intent, reconcile exact GitHub request marker before POST; ambiguous POST must never be blindly repeated
planning.usage_limit: unfinished request with exact prompt/hash, original result/comment, reported reset text/time/source/zone; durable RETRY_WAIT, one clean new request ID linked to original only after authorized reset; no successor while pending
planning.reference_consumer: emits SENIOR_REVIEW intent only, NEVER creates task or inference

presentation.failed_permanent_or_needs_review: presentation degradation only; no cursor advance pretending delivered; no blind resend
presentation.control_supersession: exact stale unattempted watchdog only, proof/hash/fingerprint/admin-auth revalidation + atomic audit; SUPERSEDED never DELIVERED

bridge.activation: verify PID/start record + exact loaded module hashes + route manifest + admin_loaded; old process must actually exit before new launch; never kill active turn
bridge.network: report localhost health and VM path independently; unknown/unreachable remote never invalidates local GitHub state

cross_side_acceptance.stale_watchdog_supersession_live_proof: REQUIRED before claiming queue cleanup complete
